1.why: The interface features a clutter-free layout without any animated elements or pop-up windows across all seven steps.

2.why: Primary call-to-action buttons and green status banners are visually distinct, although the top step tracker text overlaps.

3.why: The consistent single-column card layout makes key form elements and instructions easy to locate immediately.

4.why: The process requires completing six sequential steps with strict password complexity rules and entering multiple technical codes.

5.why: The input fields do not display any options or controls for password managers, browser autofill, or 'remember me' functionality.

6.why: The workflow requires handling complex, unfamiliar technical strings such as a 64-character token from system logs.

7.why: While main instructional text is concise, the top progress bar suffers from garbled, overlapping text.

8.why: No error states or error messages are depicted in any of the provided screenshots to confirm this statement.

9.why: Input fields do not contain placeholder text or visual examples showing expected data formats.

10.why: The system enforces a single rigid authentication sequence without offering clear choices like biometric or magic-link sign-in.

11.why: Each screen limits choices by focusing on a single task with only one or two input fields at a time.

12.why: Prominent green status banners explicitly state the result of the prior action at every step of the process.

13.why: A persistent 'Need help?' card on every screen offers guidance, security tips, and assurances about saved progress.

14.why: The help panel states progress is saved upon refresh, but no visible 'Back' navigation button is provided to correct earlier mistakes.

15.why: The application maintains complete structural and visual consistency across all seven steps of the flow.
